question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

The _______ are broken now, it seems they won't reunite.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3..**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cords"** refers to long, thin, flexible strings or ropes made from several twisted strands. (रस्सियाँ)

 
 
• **Example: **The tent was secured with strong** cords **to withstand the wind.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cored** (बीज निकालना): Refers to removing the central part of something, especially fruits.

 
 
• **Example:** She cored the apples before making the pie.
 
 
 
• **Chords** (संगीत के स्वरों का समूह): A group of notes sounded together, as a basis of harmony in music.
 
 
• **Example: **He strummed a few chords on his guitar.
 
 
 
• **Core** (मुख्य भाग): The central or most important part of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The core of the issue is the lack of communication.
 
 

3d:T9ff,
The correct answer is **Option 2.**
